storytelling_frameworks.name: The Relatable Struggle & Smart Fix
structure: Twist/Brand Moment: Introduce the brand as the smart solution (5-10s)
storytelling_frameworks.example: Hook: 'Tired of problem X?' → Build: Show how problem X ruins the day → Twist: 'But then I found Brand Y' → Brand: Explain how Brand Y fixes it → CTA: 'Link in bio to solve it today'

storytelling_frameworks.name: The Industry Secret
structure: Hook: 'What they don't want you to know about [Topic]' (0-3s)
Reveal/Brand Moment: Position the brand as the insider move (5-10s)
storytelling_frameworks.example: Hook: 'The biggest lie about X...' → Build: Explain the lie → Reveal: 'That's why smart people use Brand Y' → CTA: 'Try it yourself'

visual_hooks.split_screen: Compare the old way vs the brand way side-by-side
visual_hooks.pov: Point of view showing the user experiencing the problem, then the relief
visual_hooks.rapid_cut: Fast cuts of the problem, stopping abruptly on the solution
